solution.title: Implement iOS Lock Down Profile for iOS iPhones in Microsoft Intune for Shared Devices

products.name: Implement iOS Lock Down Profile for iOS iPhones in Microsoft Intune for Shared Devices — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable iOS lock-down profile for shared iPhones in Microsoft Intune — device restrictions plus optional kiosk — with the full provisioning and login model for both shared and corporate devices. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Lock down shared iPhones — and give staff a clear way to use both a shared and a corporate device

Many organizations hand out two kinds of iPhone: shared devices that anyone on shift picks up and uses, and corporate devices assigned to one person. The shared ones need a real lock-down profile so they stay clean, consistent, and limited to what the job needs; the corporate ones need a lighter, user-owned experience — and staff need to know exactly how to provision, sign in to, and use each. Done ad hoc, shared phones drift, get tied to whoever set them up, and users are confused about which device does what. This solution delivers a repeatable iOS lock-down profile for shared iPhones in Microsoft Intune, alongside the provisioning and login model for both shared and corporate devices.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the shared-vs-corporate iPhone model, what an iOS lock-down profile is (device restrictions, optional kiosk single/multi-app, supervised controls), the two enrollment/provisioning models (no-user-affinity shared vs user-affinity corporate), and the end-user login/use experience for each.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Apple MDM Push (APNs) certificate, Apple Business Manager + ADE token, supervised devices, device/user groups, a shared sign-in account where used, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: identity & Apple connection baseline, the shared no-user-affinity ADE enrollment, the corporate user-affinity ADE enrollment, the lock-down device-restrictions (and optional kiosk) profile for shared devices, a lighter corporate baseline, compliance & access, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • Use & Login Guide — how an end user picks up and uses a shared device (sign in to apps with the shared/managed account, hand-back/reset expectations) and how a user provisions and signs in to their own corporate device — the practical day-to-day for both.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant/device readiness discovery, per-device lock-down + enrollment-model validation, a fleet shared-vs-corporate posture report, safe remediation of drifted devices, and a shared/corporate device-group builder.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Shared iPhones locked down to exactly what the job needs, corporate iPhones kept light and user-owned, and staff who know how to provision, sign in to, and use both — managed at fleet scale in Intune, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IOSLD-Discovery.ps1 — tenant/device readiness for the iOS lock-down (shared + corporate) model
    • IOSLD-Remediation.ps1 — safe drift fixes for the shared + corporate iPhone fleet (-WhatIf default)
    • IOSLD-Report.ps1 — fleet shared-vs-corporate posture report for managed iPhones
    • IOSLD-Set-DeviceGroupTargeting.ps1 — build the shared and corporate iPhone device groups
    • IOSLD-Validation.ps1 — prove an iPhone matches its model (shared vs corporate) and is locked down

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
